name: Database fundamentals
description: Data, databases, and the role of a DBMS.

questions.answer: An organized collection of related data.
questions.explanation: A database gives data structure so it can be stored, queried, and maintained.
A DBMS provides tools to define, query, secure, and update a database.

questions.answer: Applications can be insulated from changes to data storage details.
questions.explanation: A DBMS separates logical access to data from its physical storage.
